title: Contracts
description: Display names and descriptions for the contracts in an asset's capability list. Key the row by the asset itself (identifierType ResourceId): OSS links that straight to the asset. Display only: the router doesn't read these entries, and OSS shows each one next to the contract it matches. An entry matches a listed contract when the address formats are equal and the addresses are equal after both are normalized by that format, so a different spelling of the same address still matches. Fields beyond those listed are allowed and ignored.

contracts.description: One entry per contract. Two entries for the same contract are rejected at ingest.

address.description: The contract's address, in the format addressFormat names, with no leading or trailing spaces. The router rejects an address that doesn't parse under its format.

addressFormat.description: caip10: a CAIP-10 account id (namespace:reference:address). url: an absolute URL with a scheme. opaque: any other identifier, compared exactly.

description.description: Optional longer text shown with the name.
